title: PRIVATE TOUR PERTH PREMIUM
route: Swan Valley - Fremantle - Dolphin Cruise Mandurah - Pinnacles Desert

includes: 4x International Breakfast at hotel + 3x Lunch as per itinerary
Canal & Dolphin Boat Cruises at Mandurah
excludes: Private Transport & Driving Guide extra hour surcharge AUD50/hour (pay cash to driver)
Airport transfer surcharge 10:01PM - 5:59AM (AUD50 flat, charged before arrival)

itinerary.title: Swan Valley Guided Tour
activities: Free & Easy, or add-on trip to fruit orchard / tulip park (optional, seasonal)

itinerary.title: Fremantle Day Tour
activities: Canal & Dolphin Boat Cruises at Mandurah (included)

itinerary.title: Perth City Tour
activities: Hay Street Mall including London Court

expect.title: Pinnacles Desert & Sand Dunes Activity
expect.body: This trip & activity is less suitable for elderly or underage children due to loose and uneven surface, as it can cause the risk of falls and twisted ankle.

expect.title: 4 Star Hotel
expect.body: Accommodation for 4 Star Hotel located at Perth CBD area. Note: Hotel provides international style breakfast buffet (Halal friendly options like bread, cereal, pastries & vegetarian food is available).

expect.title: Room Allocation
expect.body: Room allocation for 4 Star Hotel will be twin sharing or triple sharing subject to availability. Interconnecting rooms are limited, subject to availability.

expect.title: Transportation & Guide
expect.body: Tour duration/transport usage as mentioned in itinerary. AUD50/hour will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash to driver.

expect.title: Arrival & Departure
expect.body: Additional surcharge applies to airport transfers between 10:01 PM - 05:59 AM. Please arrive & depart between 06:00 AM - 10:00 PM to avoid additional charges.

expect.title: Peak Seasons Date
expect.body: Peak Seasons Surcharge may apply on these dates: 19 - 31 March 2026, 1 - 20 April 2026, 1 - 15 July 2026, 19 - 31 August 2026, 1 - 30 September 2026, 1 - 30 November 2026, 1 - 20 December 2026, 21 December 2026 - 20 February 2027.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Most halal restaurants in Perth usually open at 10:00 AM and above. You can take the free city bus to go to restaurants during your free time.

expect.title: Free & Easy Day
expect.body: Halfday Free & Easy Day 2. No transport or guide is provided but you can explore Perth City on your own. Recommended to use free city buses for city tour.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2@3 person per room (Additional RM2500/person for Single Supplement).
Full payment has to be made 45 days prior arrival.
Late Booking Surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
Private Transportation & Driving Guide is based on the hours stated in the itinerary. AUD50/hour will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Airport transfer arrival/return at 10:01pm to 5:59am, AUD50 additional surcharge will be imposed during this hour. Please arrive/return between 6:00am to 10:00pm to avoid charges.
Quotation, Itinerary and price is subject to change accordingly.
Hotel location will be confirmed at least 15 days before departure.
This package is valid until 31st March 2027 travel period.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.
